change: a request over the token limits (32,768 for the state plus one question, 65,536 for the whole request) only because of the read-twice layout is read once, without the repetition
suite: Decision Index text public suite, edition 0.3, with the board's tool
method: the request chunks refused before the change, plus a fixed hash sample of answered chunks (md5(run_id) mod 140620 < 1500), re-run with the changed server; all other chunks are kept from the run before the change. Same checkpoint and settings (VEV_READ_TWICE=full, VEV_BIDIR=state).
note: Differences in the sample are in requests with several questions, whose batching depends on free GPU memory.
